s31.before: 31 Implementation capabilities Connect decision models to operating systems Operational intelligence combines forecasts, simulation, optimization, execution, and feedback. Decision modeling Translate operating goals into decision variables, constraints, and objectives. Prediction and uncertainty Estimate audience outcomes and describe the uncertainty around those estimates. Combinatorial optimization Search feasible allocations of films, auditoriums, showtimes, and formats. Simulation Evaluate candidate decisions before they enter operating systems. System integration Connect models and decision services to APIs, data stores, and operator interfaces. Continuous learning Record actions and observed outcomes to update models and future decisions. s31.after: 31 Part VII — A daily operator run A natural operating sequence: inputs → settings → search → timetable The operator starts from a reference schedule, reviews a recommendation, and carries the selected plan into the next cycle. 01 · Import planning inputs Load films, screens, operating rules and the reference timetable into one planning workspace. 02 · Set the planning goal Choose the audience objective, available operating window and search budget. 03 · Run feasible search Evaluate candidate film allocations and showtimes while respecting screen and timing constraints. 04 · Inspect the recommendation Compare expected audiences, screen utilization and changed time slots with the reference. 05 · Review and export Keep the selected plan, record operator edits and export the timetable for publication. 06 · Learn and replan Return booking and attendance outcomes to the models and update eligible future screenings. Operator workflow · Import → configure → optimize → inspect → publish → update
